name: 15219 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15219 (Pittsburgh) has 348 nonprofit organizations. 190 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 163 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15219 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15219 (Pittsburgh) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.4 times the typical level).
